mentions.name: Sorso
mentions.description: A progressive web app for logging and improving coffee brewing. It lets users see what their group is drinking, find new coffees, explore new cafes, and understand what they like and don't like.
mentions.audience: Primarily used by the author's group of friends
mentions.source_excerpt: A fresh PWA to log / improve your coffee brewing process. We use it to see what we are all drinking, find new coffees, explore new cafes, and understand what we like / don’t like.
